title: fix(console): the bare data page opens a record by the list's one rule

## 维护者速读

- 控制台的裸数据页上，点记录名称改为进整页；鼠标移到一行时名称旁出现「在侧边打开」小图标，点它才从右侧打开抽屉；从整页点关闭回到原来带条件的数据页。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题，让数据页跟上对象列表已定的打开规则，两处入口不再不一样。
- 用数据页看记录的人会碰到；出错时最多是点名称打不开或回不到原页，改动可以整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The bare data page (`ObjectDataPage`, the app's object `data` route) now opens a record by the list's one rule, the one the object list (`ObjectView`) follows since the parent card's ruling:

- **The record's name opens the full page** (`.../record/ID`). A card (kanban, gallery, calendar) and a touch tap on a row open the full page too; a ⌘/Ctrl or middle click still opens it in a new tab.
- **The name cell's 「Open in side panel」 icon opens the side drawer** over the list, through `?recordId=`, exactly as before for the drawer itself. It is the same `OpenInSidePanelButton` the object list draws (hover/focus revealed, no icon on a coarse pointer), handed to the grid on the same host channel (`recordLinkAdornment`). A phone (`usePhoneViewport`) draws no icon, as on the object list.
- **On a phone the page is pushed over the data page**: the name's navigation state carries `RECORD_PAGE_PUSHED_STATE`, exactly as the object list's open path adds it on a phone, so the page's 「‹」 goes back in the history to the data page's entry (its scroll kept, no duplicate list entry) instead of navigating forward to it.
- **The full page carries the data page as its origin**: the history-state `from` holds the data page's URL with its conditions (`filter[...]`, `uf_*`, the source trail), its name (the object's plural label, the page's own title), the rows it shows and the count it matched. So the page's top bar counts the record among those rows, its ↑ ↓ step through them, and its ✕ returns to the data page with its conditions.
- **A click on any other cell still opens nothing**: it selects the cell (the grid's select-first model, unchanged).
- A list-only object's rows still open nothing, and draw no icon. A `?recordId=` link still opens the drawer.

One builder for the origin, so the two entries cannot drift: `listOriginOf` (in `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`) is now what both the object list's open path and the data page call. The object list's call is a move of the inline code it replaces, byte-for-byte in what it produces; `ObjectView`'s behaviour is unchanged (its open-path suites are in the run below).

Not here: the data page's drawer has no ⤢ 「Open as full page」 (it had none before either); see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

Added `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx`, driving the real `ObjectDataPage`, `ListView` grid and `MePermissionsProvider`, with the record route reading the origin through `useRecordPageReturn` (the hook the page's top bar uses):

- the name opens the full page, whose `from` is the data page's URL with its condition, its name, its rows and its matched count, and whose position reads 1 of the matched count;
- the hover icon opens the drawer (`?recordId=`), the list stays;
- a click on another cell opens nothing;
- the page's ✕ returns to the data page with its condition;
- a list-only object draws no icon and its name opens no page;
- on a phone viewport (390 px) the name's navigation state carries the pushed-page marker; the desktop case asserts it does not.

Migrated: `ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx`, the data page's CONTROL case: a touch tap on a cell now opens the record page (it pinned the drawer, the behaviour this card replaces).

## Acceptance notes

- Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` (`handleRecordClick`, `recordLinkAdornment`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (`listOriginOf` and its one caller in `handleNavOverlayNavigate`).
- Two-minute check: open any object's data page in the Console (`/apps/APP/OBJECT/data?filter[FIELD]=VALUE`), click a record's name: the full page opens and its top bar names the object's list; click ✕: back on the data page with the condition chip. Hover a row and click the small panel icon after the name: the drawer opens over the list.
- The data page's drawer draws no ⤢ 「Open as full page」, before and after this change (the object list's drawer has one). Carried by #36300.
- The data page keeps no page number in its address (the object list does), so a record opened from page 3 and closed with ✕ returns to the data page's first page, while the page's ↑ ↓ still step through page 3's rows. New with this change (the drawer used to open over the list and keep its page). Read from code, not measured on a running page. Carried by #36299.
